title: Retest round 6 — Mahmoud Mohamed · NDC · 47 CRM tickets

devNote: Developer comments on 2 of 47 tickets (NDC-1444, NDC-1172, both 21 Oct "FIXED"). Staging outage 26 Oct ~14:30–(next morning); the 9 blocked tickets were retested on 27 Oct after recovery.

tickets.title: Audit Log | No audit events are recorded after 20 Oct 21:41 UTC — record changes, metadata changes and sign-ins are missing
tickets.summary: Rerun 27 Oct after the outage: record create/update/delete and setup changes appear in the Audit Log (AuditLogTest recordLifecycleIsLogged, setupChangesAreLogged).

tickets.title: Deals | The record API ignores the pipeline — creates always land on the default pipeline and updates never move a deal
tickets.summary: Blocker found: Deals has a CUSTOM pick-list field with api name "pipeline" (created 24 Oct by ndc-staging-owner on layout "Wonder Travel", allowed only "Standard (Standard)") that validates every deal's pipeline → 422. Widened for the test and restored exactly. Then: create on pipeline "1" → stored on "1"; PATCH a Standard deal to "1" → moved with stage test-01; stage not in "1" → 422.

tickets.title: Hierarchy Preference | Role mode: higher-ranked users can't see lower-ranked users' records
tickets.summary: Against the expected rule given by the user on 27 Oct (same profile never; higher rank sees lower ranks in the SAME org unit only; other org units never; owner sees all): 7 cases follow it (I2, I2b, I1/I5, I3b, I7, I4, I8); 2 do not — I3 a Supervisor does not see a User's leads in the same org unit, and I4b a Manager in another org unit DOES see a User's leads. Visibility follows the profile parent tree tenant-wide, ignoring org unit and rank.
still: I3: Supervisor (300) does not see a lower-ranked User (100)'s leads in the same org unit.
I4b: Manager (500) in another org unit (HR) sees a User's leads in Sales.

tickets.title: Hierarchy Preference | Reporting mode: a manager can't see their direct report's records
tickets.summary: Reporting mode (VisibilityTest): reporting manager sees the direct report's leads; also as Supervisor; report cannot see manager; user outside the chain sees nothing. Indirect (2 levels) not checked (needs a third user without view-all).

tickets.summary: HierarchyApiTest.userCannotSetOwnManager: a User-profile user can no longer change their own reporting manager through PUT /iam/me/profile; admin endpoint still refused.
